title: Checkout Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
root_cause: Database connections were not released correctly after a deployment, exhausting the connection pool.
resolution: Rolled back the deployment and verified database connection pool recovery.

title: Checkout Service CPU Saturation
root_cause: An inefficient request-processing loop caused excessive CPU consumption.
resolution: Rolled back the application change and optimized request processing.

title: Authentication Brute Force Alert
root_cause: Automated credential-guessing attempts from an external source.
resolution: Applied rate limiting and temporarily blocked suspicious sources after security review.

title: Payment Gateway Timeout
root_cause: An external payment provider experienced elevated latency.
resolution: Enabled a controlled fallback and monitored provider recovery.
